## Foods & dishes
- [[World Wide Dishes]]: **40 dishes (36 Uganda-only)**; free-text ingredients, no amounts or method, plus eating context (time of day, occasion, utensils, local-language name). Luganda 27 dishes; regions Central 8, Northern 5, Western 4. Examples: ekitobero, malakwang, boo, yams and groundnuts, dried sweet-potato slices.
- [[WorldCuisines]]: 7 dishes (4 Uganda-only: mugoyo, malewa, kikomando, rolex); Wikipedia-style descriptions naming ingredients, no amounts.
- [[FmLAMA]]: 2 dishes (katogo, mugoyo); Wikidata ingredient lists, no amounts.

## Ingredients & food composition
- No national FCT is in the vault or `Backlog/`. The [[FAO INFOODS global databases]] candidate (priority 2, directory of 308 tables) is where a national or regional table would be found. Fallback: [[USDA FoodData Central]] by name matching.
- Plant occurrence: [[CMAUP]] 118 plants; [[NPASS]] 18 pairs.

## Compounds & traditional medicine
- [[Dr. Duke's Phytochemical and Ethnobotanical Databases|Duke]]: 7 ethnobotany records only. [[KNApSAcK Family]] lists Uganda on its World map, but African flag pages were not scraped (counts unknown).
- Compound → effect chains come from the global backbone via [[Global]] ([[FooDB]], [[CTD]], [[Phenol-Explorer]], [[SpiceRx]], [[DDID]] for food–drug interactions).

## Gaps
- No Ugandan FCT and no recipes with amounts.
- Northern and eastern food cultures are thin next to Buganda.
- Traditional-medicine data is essentially absent.
